props.text: No tracked input, one output - e.g. receiving raw material or finished goods into the system for the first time.

config.script:
card = self.parent.parent
	lblResult = self.getSibling("lbl_result")
	opName = card.getChild("row_name").getChild("txt_opName").props.text
	opEquipment = card.getChild("row_equipment").getChild("eq_operation").props.selectedMESObject.equipmentPath
	
	try:
		lotNoOut1 = card.getChild("row_out1_lot").getChild("lotno_out_1").props.text
		materialNameOut1 = card.getChild("row_out1_mat").getChild("mat_out_1").props.selectedMESObject.name
		qtyOut1 = card.getChild("row_out1_qty").getChild("qty_out_1").props.value
		destOut1 = card.getChild("row_out1_dest").getChild("eq_out_1").props.selectedMESObject.equipmentPath
		
		Trace.OperationPatterns.recordReceive(
			opName, opEquipment,
			materialNameOut1, lotNoOut1, qtyOut1, destOut1)
		
		lblResult.props.text = "Recorded: " + opName
		lblResult.props.style = {"color": "#2e7d32", "fontWeight": "600"}
	except Exception, e:
		lblResult.props.text = "Error: " + str(e)
		lblResult.props.style = {"color": "#c62828", "fontWeight": "600"}
